AccessToken.description: Access token of the client application.

Client.description: Name and version of the client application.

Limitation.description: Limitation on the quantity of data returned and optional Cursor for the starting point of data.

EnterpriseIds.description: Unique identifiers of the Enterprises. If not specified, the operation returns data for all enterprises within scope of the Access Token.

ServiceOrderIds.description: Unique identifiers of `Service order`. Reservation IDs or Order IDs can be used as service order identifiers.

ServiceOrderNoteIds.description: Unique identifiers of `Service order note`. Use this property if you want to fetch specific service order notes.

UpdatedUtc.title: Time interval
UpdatedUtc.description: Timestamp in UTC timezone ISO 8601 format when the service order note was updated.

Types.description: Type of the service order note. Defaults to `["General", "ChannelManager"]`.
